## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates end-to-end Key Certificate Authority (KCA) design in a highly distributed edge environment featuring Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), offline operation requirements, and cryptographic agility demands.

- Hardware root of trust combined with TEE attestation to regional bootstrap services

- Short-lived TLS certificates with 900-second TTL
- Cryptographic agility incorporating post-quantum cryptography fallback mechanisms
- Cross-region trust anchor coordination and management
- Certificate revocation and comprehensive auditing capabilities
- Secure over-the-air (OTA) signing processes
- Offline operation and network partition resilience strategies

## Assessment Focus
The evaluation targets understanding of distributed certificate management, secure edge device provisioning, cryptographic agility for future-proofing, and operational resilience in challenging network conditions.
